project.title: [Company] — Signature Brand Build
project.summary: Bespoke signature brand programme including deep strategy, custom identity system, extensive collateral, motion/brand film, and implementation support.
objectives: Deep brand strategy and positioning for market differentiation
Custom signature identity system (logo, motion, sonic, experiential)
Extensive collateral and environmental brand applications
Brand film/motion system for digital presence

included: Deep brand strategy programme (research, workshops, positioning, architecture)
Signature identity system: custom logo, motion logo, sonic branding, brand behaviours
Extended visual language: custom typography, illustration system, iconography, photography art direction
Extensive collateral: stationery, environmental, packaging, digital, social, advertising templates
Implementation support: team workshops, vendor briefings, rollout planning
Digital asset library with component system
exclusions: Ongoing brand maintenance (Brand Care is separate and optional)
Custom photography/illustration production beyond art direction

timeline.notes: Bespoke scope; final schedule confirmed at agreement after discovery

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

client_responsibilities: Timely feedback on strategy, concepts, design, and guidelines review stages
Stakeholder availability for deep strategy workshops
Approval of collateral content and production specs before finalisation
Access to vendors/partners for implementation coordination
assumptions: Approved Final Project Price is the contractual commercial basis, not the public From price
No third-party production costs are included without prior approval
Bespoke scope requires a signed scope document before development starts
Asset library is delivered via shared cloud folder; client manages access
next_steps: Following acceptance, a commercial agreement and scope document are executed before invoicing
